assessment: Local data classification for exactly these 48 bytes is justified: each complete aligned little-endian word is the computed destination of at least one listed 16-bit Thumb PC-relative LDR instruction, and every listed opcode and target was checked against the locked raw image. The 2-byte predecessor remains outside this classification.
limitations: Load-site coordinates are inherited from the historical evidence; this review verifies each listed instruction and its arithmetic but does not independently discover every LDR reference in the image.
The check does not prove that any site is reachable or executed at runtime, nor that the image has no additional entry points or nested executable content.
The 48-byte local classification does not classify neighboring bytes or establish whole-image pseudocode coverage, source completeness, or byte-identical rebuild qualification.
The verifier validates its own listed candidates; it does not independently establish the historical evidence's Ghidra function-range authentication or GNU disassembly provenance.
